scope: accepted 200 trials only; offline arithmetic, no fit or new experiment

definitions.strict_count_bounds: 0 <= counted S1 HPM increments inside V hardware window <= software-bracket S1 counter difference; counter semantics/monotonicity and ordered accesses assumed
definitions.true_walks: A count of all actual walks needs event-count calibration; the bounds above are on recorded increments, not missed events
definitions.overhang_duration: configured-clock conversion only; [Tsw-20*Thw, Tsw-20*Thw+snapshot_before+snapshot_after]; per-counter sample timestamps are absent
definitions.sensitivity: Nsw + [-2,-1,0,1,2] is an assumption sensitivity, never a measured error bound
definitions.no_narrow_bound: No narrow bound inferred from whole A copies, assumed hot tail, or post-translation boundary counters; complete upstream cross-boundary state is not audited
definitions.path: each trial sum/full of ingress-address handshake to first output VALID; queueing plus translation/buffering latency, not pure wait or PTW
definitions.paired: Ak minus A1 within exact raw file, boot and block, then group medians; DS50 pools two observed boots for description
definitions.nonadditivity: 8192*delta(mean) is summed overlapping burst residence; it is not elapsed time or an additive causal partition
definitions.independence: path and HPM are distinct observer mechanisms on the same execution/boot, not independent experiments or per-request hit classifications
